answer.summary: A narrow, empirically grounded research question is required to investigate measurable output token coherence under intermittent input with bounded token budgets and known perturbations.
answer.content: Propose a research question focused on time-series output token coherence in a tokenized agent under intermittent input streams with known perturbations, using per-interval drift scores and decay rate metrics anchored to a single peer-reviewed study on linguistic coherence in autoregressive models. The query must specify experimental conditions, time frames, and bounded token constraints to ensure testability and alignment with available empirical data.
